WHERE rows ko filter karta hai — GROUP BY se pehle chalta hai, isme aggregate functions nahi use kar sakte. HAVING groups ko filter karta hai — GROUP BY ke baad chalta hai, isme SUM/COUNT use kar sakte ho.

Q: EXPLAIN kya karta hai?

EXPLAIN batata hai database query ko kaise chalayega — kaunsa index use hoga, kitni rows scan hongi, kis order me tables judengi. Slow query ko optimize karne ka pehla step EXPLAIN dekhna hai.

8. Quick check

Sawaal 1: SQL me sabse pehle kaunsa clause chalta hai?

  • SELECT
  • FROM ✓ Sahi jawab
  • WHERE
  • ORDER BY

Sawaal 2: WHERE me SELECT ka alias kyun use nahi kar sakte?

  • Alias allowed nahi hai
  • WHERE SELECT se pehle chalta hai — alias abhi bana hi nahi ✓ Sahi jawab
  • Alias sirf ORDER BY me chalta hai
  • Database ko alias pasand nahi
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: SQL likhne ka order ≠ chalne ka order: FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT; WHERE rows ko, HAVING groups ko filter karta hai; EXPLAIN se execution plan dekho.
Sourcehttps://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/visualizing-a-sql-query.md
Pichla09 · OSI Model ExplainedAgla11 · Explaining 8 Popular Network Protocols in 1 Diagram
11Computer Fundamentals · Guide 11 / 12

Explaining 8 Popular Network Protocols in 1 Diagram

Internet pe data kaise travel karta hai? Iske peeche 8 popular protocols hain — har ek ka apna kaam, apni layer, apna port. Is page me aathon ko ek saath samjho: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SMTP, DNS, TCP, UDP aur SSH — ek hi kahani me.

1. 8 protocols — ek sheher ki services

Socho internet ek sheher hai: HTTP/HTTPS = sheher ki dukaan (website dekhna), FTP = samaan bhejne wali courier service (files), SMTP = daak khana (email bhejna), DNS = phonebook (naam se number nikaalna), TCP = registered post (guaranteed delivery), UDP = postcard (fast, par guarantee nahi), SSH = secret tunnel (secure remote access).

Har service ka apna port number hota hai — jaise har dukaan ka apna address. Port dekh ke pata chalta hai packet kis service ke liye hai.

2. Gehrai me samjho — ek-ek point

HTTP aur HTTPS — web ke protocols

HTTP (port 80): Web pages laane ka protocol — browser request bhejta hai (GET/POST), server HTML bhejta hai. Plain text me — koi encryption nahi.

HTTPS (port 443): HTTP + TLS — encrypted, authenticated, tamper-proof. Aaj ki har site HTTPS pe hai — browser HTTP wali ko 'Not Secure' kehta hai.

Farq: HTTP postcard hai, HTTPS band lifafa. Dono ka kaam ek hai (web), par HTTPS safe hai.

FTP aur SMTP — files aur email

FTP (port 21): Files transfer karne ka purana protocol — server pe file chadhao/utaro. Plain text me password jata hai — isliye aaj SFTP (SSH ke upar) ya FTPS use karte hain.

SMTP (port 25/587): Email bhejne ka protocol — tumhara email server se nikal ke doosre server tak jata hai. Email padhne ke liye IMAP (143) ya POP3 (110) use hota hai.

Example: Gmail se email bhejo — SMTP se Gmail server pe, phir wahan se receiver ke server pe (SMTP), receiver IMAP se padhta hai.

DNS — internet ki phonebook

DNS (port 53): Naam ko IP me badalta hai — google.com → 142.250.80.46. Har website kholne se pehle DNS lookup hota hai.

UDP pe chalta hai (fast, chhoti query) — bade responses ke liye TCP. DNS over HTTPS (DoH) se queries bhi encrypt hoti hain.

Bina DNS ke internet use karna impossible hai — har IP yaad rakhna padta.

TCP, UDP aur SSH — neeche ki parat

TCP (Layer 4): Reliable delivery — order, retransmission, flow control. Web, email, file transfer — jahan data kho jaye to tabahi hai.

UDP (Layer 4): Fast, unreliable — video calls, gaming, DNS. Jahan speed > reliability.

SSH (port 22): Secure remote access — server ka terminal encrypted tunnel se. Telnet ka secure replacement — file transfer (SCP/SFTP) aur port forwarding bhi karta hai.

WebSocket — guide ka 8th protocol (page ke SSH ke alawa)

WebSocket ek protocol hai jo TCP ke upar full-duplex communication deta hai — matlab client aur server ek hi connection pe dono taraf se kabhi bhi data bhej sakte hain. Client WebSocket connection establish karta hai, aur phir back-end se real-time updates milte rehte hain.

REST se farq: REST hamesha "pull" karta hai — client baar-baar poochta hai "kuch naya hai?" WebSocket "push" karta hai — server ke paas naya data aate hi client ko bhej deta hai, bina poochhe.

Kahan use hota hai: online gaming (live player positions), stock trading (live prices), messaging apps (chat messages) — jahan bhi real-time updates chahiye, wahan WebSocket hai.

Yaad rakhne wali baat: guide ke 8 protocols ye hain — HTTP, DNS, HTTPS, WebSocket, TCP, UDP, SMTP, FTP. Inme se WebSocket is page ke tabs me nahi tha, isliye yahan alag se diya hai. SSH is page ka extra hai — secure remote access ke liye, jo system design me bhi aata hai.

3. 8 protocols — ek table me

ProtocolPortLayerKaamSecure?
HTTP80ApplicationWeb pages❌ Plain
HTTPS443ApplicationSecure web✅ TLS
FTP21ApplicationFile transfer❌ (SFTP use karo)
SMTP25 / 587ApplicationEmail bhejna⚠ (STARTTLS se)
DNS53ApplicationNaam → IP⚠ (DoH se)
TCP—TransportReliable delivery—
UDP—TransportFast delivery—
SSH22ApplicationSecure remote login✅ Encrypted

4. Try karo — ek din, 8 protocols

Subah uth ke tumne kya-kya kiya — email bheja, website kholi, video call ki, file download ki. Har kaam me kaunsa protocol chala?

  1. 1. Subah — website kholo
    • → Tumne google.com khola
    • → Pehle DNS (port 53, UDP): google.com → 142.250.80.46
    • → Phir TCP connect (port 443) + TLS handshake
    • → HTTPS se request gayi, HTML aaya ✓
    • → Protocols: DNS + TCP + HTTPS — teeno ek saath!
  2. 2. Email bhejo
    • → Gmail pe email likhi, Send dabhaya
    • → SMTP (port 587): email Gmail server ko gayi
    • → Gmail server ne receiver ke server ko SMTP se bheji
    • → Receiver ne IMAP (port 993) se padhi ✓
    • → Protocols: SMTP + IMAP
  3. 3. Video call karo
    • → Zoom call shuru ki
    • → Video/audio UDP se gaya — fast, real-time ✓
    • → Ek frame kho gaya to chalega, agla aa gaya
    • → Login aur chat TCP se hue (reliability chahiye)
    • → Protocols: UDP (media) + TCP (signaling)
  4. 4. Server pe file chadhao
    • → File server pe daalni hai: SFTP use kiya (port 22)
    • → SSH tunnel bana — encrypted ✓
    • → File transfer hui — FTP hota to password plain jata!
    • → Protocols: SSH + SFTP
  5. 5. Game khelo
    • → Game server se judo — UDP se position updates
    • → Shoot kiya — reliable UDP packet (dobara bhej ke guarantee)
    • → Game download TCP se hua tha (ek byte bhi nahi khona)
    • → Protocols: UDP (gameplay) + TCP (download)

5. Port numbers yaad rakhne ki trick

PortProtocolYaad rakhne ka tareeka
21FTPFile Transfer — 21 saal me adult (file bhej sakte ho)
22SSHSecure Shell — 22, do-do (double secure)
25 / 587SMTPMail bhejna
53DNSPhonebook — 53
80HTTPWeb — 80, sabse famous
443HTTPSSecure web — 443

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. HTTP aur HTTPS ko ek samajhna: HTTP plain hai, HTTPS encrypted — aaj HTTP pe password kabhi mat dalo.
  2. FTP se password bhejna: FTP plain text me password bhejta hai — SFTP use karo.
  3. TCP aur UDP ko mix karna: TCP reliable, UDP fast — use case dekh ke chuno. Dono ke ports bhi alag hote hain.
  4. DNS ko bhoolna: Har connection se pehle DNS hota hai — slow DNS matlab slow internet. Fast resolver use karo.
  5. Port numbers ko yaad na karna: Interview me ports poochte hain — 80, 443, 22, 53, 25 ye 5 to yaad rakho hi.

7. Interview corner

Q: 8 popular protocols kaunse hain aur har ek ka kaam kya hai?

HTTP (80, web), HTTPS (443, secure web), FTP (21, files), SMTP (25/587, email bhejna), DNS (53, naam→IP), TCP (reliable transport), UDP (fast transport), SSH (22, secure remote login). Har ek ki apni layer aur port hai.

Q: TCP aur UDP me farq?

TCP reliable hai — order, retransmission, flow control; web/email/files ke liye. UDP fast hai — no connection, no guarantee; video/gaming/DNS ke liye. Dono Transport layer (Layer 4) pe hain.

Q: Email bhejne aur padhne me kaunse protocols?

Bhejne ke liye SMTP (port 587), padhne ke liye IMAP (993) ya POP3 (110). SMTP sirf bhejne ka kaam karta hai — isliye email bhejo to SMTP, inbox dekho to IMAP.

8. Quick check

Sawaal 1: Website kholne ke liye sabse pehle kaunsa protocol chalta hai?

  • HTTP
  • DNS — naam ko IP me badalne ke liye ✓ Sahi jawab
  • FTP
  • SMTP

Sawaal 2: Email bhejne ke liye kaunsa protocol use hota hai?

  • IMAP
  • SMTP ✓ Sahi jawab
  • FTP
  • SSH
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: 8 protocols: HTTP/HTTPS (web), FTP (files), SMTP (email bhejna), DNS (naam→IP), TCP (reliable), UDP (fast), SSH (secure login); har ek ka apna port aur layer hai; use case dekh ke chuno.
Sourcehttps://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/explaining-8-popular-network-protocols-in-1-diagram.md
Pichla10 · Visualizing a SQL QueryAgla12 · What is the Best Way to Learn SQL?
12Computer Fundamentals · Guide 12 / 12

What is the Best Way to Learn SQL?

SQL har developer ko aana chahiye — data analyst ho, backend developer ho, ya data engineer. Par SQL seekhne ka sahi tareeka kya hai? Random tutorials dekhna nahi — ek structured raasta hai: basics → queries → joins → aggregation → real projects. Is page me wo poora roadmap hai.

1. SQL seekhna — khana banana seekhne jaisa

Khana banana seekhna ho to pehle chhota kaam seekhte ho — chai banana. Phir dal-chawal. Phir ek poora thaali. Ek din me biryani nahi banti.

SQL bhi wahi hai: pehle SELECT (data dekhna), phir WHERE (filter karna), phir JOIN (tables jodna), phir GROUP BY (hisab karna), phir subqueries aur window functions (advanced). Har step pe practice — bina likhe SQL nahi aayega, sirf dekhne se nahi.

Golden rule: SQL dekh ke nahi, likh ke seekhi jati hai. Har concept ke baad 10 queries khud likho — tabhi aayegi.

2. Gehrai me samjho — ek-ek point

Stage 1 — Basics (Week 1-2)

Seekho: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT. Data ko dekhna aur filter karna. SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age > 18 ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 10;

Practice: Ek sample database lo (PostgreSQL ka dvdrental, ya MySQL ka sakila, ya SQLite ka chinook). Har roz 10 queries likho — '18 saal se bade users ka naam batao', 'sabse mehenga product kaunsa hai?'

Tools: DB Browser for SQLite (free, easy), ya PostgreSQL + pgAdmin. Online: SQLBolt, Mode SQL Tutorial (free, interactive).

Stage 2 — Joins aur Aggregation (Week 3-4)

Joins: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL JOIN — tables ko jodna. Ye SQL ka sabse important aur sabse confusing topic hai — Venn diagram se samjho, phir practice karo.

Aggregation: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX + GROUP BY + HAVING. 'Har customer ne kitna kharcha kiya?' — SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

Practice: LeetCode SQL (easy), HackerRank SQL, StrataScratch — roz 3-5 questions. Joins ke bina real kaam nahi hota — is stage ko halke me mat lo.

Stage 3 — Advanced (Week 5-8)

Subqueries: Query ke andar query. CTEs (WITH): Query ko readable banao. Window functions: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG/LEAD — 'har department ke top 3 employees kaun hain?' — bina window function ke mushkil hai.

CASE WHEN, UNION, EXISTS: Conditional logic aur set operations. Indexes aur EXPLAIN: Query fast kaise banayein — interview me bhi poochte hain.

Practice: LeetCode SQL (medium), real datasets (Kaggle) pe analysis karo — 'is dataset se 5 insights nikaalo'.

Stage 4 — Real Projects aur Interview (Week 9+)

Project: Ek chhota project banao — apni kharchon ki tracker (SQLite + Python), ya ek blog ka database design karo. Real data pe kaam karna hi asli seekh hai.

Interview prep: 'Top N per group', 'second highest salary', 'duplicate rows nikalo' — ye classic questions hain, inhe likh ke practice karo. Database design: Normalization, primary/foreign keys, indexes — sirf query likhna kaafi nahi, design bhi aana chahiye.

Keep learning: SQL ke baad — ek database ko deeply seekho (PostgreSQL), phir data modeling, phir thoda NoSQL (MongoDB) bhi dekh lo.

SQL ke 5 components — pehle ye samjho, phir roadmap

SQL ek hi bhasha nahi hai — iske 5 hisse hain. Kaunsa kab kaam aata hai, ye samajh lo to seekhna aasan ho jata hai:

ComponentPoora naamKaamExamples
DDLData Definition LanguageStructure banana / badalnaCREATE, ALTER, DROP
DQLData Query LanguageData padhna / poochnaSELECT
DMLData Manipulation LanguageData badalnaINSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
DCLData Control LanguagePermission dena / lenaGRANT, REVOKE
TCLTransaction Control LanguageTransaction sambhalnaCOMMIT, ROLLBACK

Kaun kitna seekhe: backend engineer ko lagbhag sab kuch chahiye hota hai. Data analyst ko DQL (SELECT, joins, aggregation) sabse zyada chahiye. Apne role ke hisaab se topics chuno — sab kuch ek saath seekhne ki koshish mat karo.

3. 8-week roadmap — ek table me

WeekTopicPractice
1SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMITSQLBolt, 10 queries/roz
2DISTINCT, LIKE, BETWEEN, NULL handlingSample DB pe 20 queries
3JOINs (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL)LeetCode Easy, Venn diagrams
4GROUP BY, HAVING, aggregatesHackerRank SQL
5Subqueries aur CTEsLeetCode Medium
6Window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK)StrataScratch
7Indexes, EXPLAIN, query optimizationApni queries ko EXPLAIN karo
8Project + interview questionsKharcha tracker project
-- Aaj ki practice query (khud try karo):
-- "Har department ke top 2 sabse zyada salary wale employees kaun hain?"
SELECT name, department, salary FROM (
  SELECT name, department, salary,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rn
  FROM employees
) t WHERE rn <= 2;

4. Try karo — apni pehli queries likho

Ek chhoti si users table hai. 4 levels ki queries likho — aasan se mushkil tak. Har level pe dekho query kya karti hai.

  1. Level 1 — SELECT aur WHERE
    • → Table: users (id, name, age, city)
    • → Query: SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age > 18;
    • → Result: 18+ wale users ke naam aur umar
    • → Tumne pehli query chala li! ✓
    • → Try karo: sirf Delhi wale users dikhao (WHERE city = 'Delhi')
  2. Level 2 — ORDER BY aur LIMIT
    • → Query: SELECT name, age FROM users ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 3;
    • → Result: sabse bade 3 users — pehle dikhe
    • → ORDER BY sort karta hai, LIMIT sirf utni rows deta hai
    • → Try karo: sabse chhote 5 users dikhao (ORDER BY age ASC LIMIT 5)
  3. Level 3 — JOIN
    • → Tables: users + orders (user_id se jude hain)
    • → Query: SELECT users.name, orders.amount FROM users JOIN orders ON users.id = orders.user_id;
    • → Result: har order ke saath user ka naam
    • → LEFT JOIN hota to bina order wale users bhi dikhte
    • → Joins hi SQL ka sabse powerful hissa hai!
  4. Level 4 — GROUP BY
    • → Query: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total FROM users GROUP BY city;
    • → Result: har sheher me kitne users hain
    • → HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 — sirf wahi sheher jahan 10+ users hain
    • → Tum ab aggregation kar sakte ho — data analysis shuru! ✓
  5. Level 5 — Window function (advanced)
    • → Query: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY age DESC)
    • → Result: har sheher ka sabse bada user (rank 1)
    • → Bina window function ke ye query bahut mushkil hoti
    • → Tum advanced level pe pahunch gaye — interview ready! ✓

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Sirf videos dekhna, practice na karna: SQL haath se likhne se aati hai — har concept ke baad khud queries likho.
  2. Joins ko skip karna: Joins ke bina real SQL kaam nahi hota — ye sabse important topic hai, ispe sabse zyada time do.
  3. SELECT * ki aadat: Real kaam me sirf zaroori columns lo — SELECT * slow hai aur interview me bhi galat mana jata hai.
  4. Ek hi database pe atakna: Pehle ek seekho (PostgreSQL), par syntax ka farq samjho — MySQL aur SQL Server me chhote farq hote hain.
  5. Interview questions ko ratna: Pattern samjho, ratto mat — 'second highest salary' ke 3 tareeke seekho, ek rat ke nahi.

7. Interview corner

Q: SQL seekhne ka best tareeka kya hai?

Structured roadmap: pehle basics (SELECT/WHERE), phir joins aur aggregation, phir advanced (subqueries, window functions), phir real project. Har stage pe daily practice — SQL likh ke seekhi jati hai, dekh ke nahi. LeetCode/HackerRank pe questions karo.

Q: Joins kyun sabse important hain?

Kyunki real databases me data kai tables me banta hota hai — users ek table me, orders doosri me. Inhe jode bina koi useful jawab nahi milega. INNER, LEFT, RIGHT JOIN ka farq aur kab kaunsa use karna hai — ye interview me pakka poochte hain.

Q: Window functions kya hain?

Window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG) rows ko group kiye bina unpe calculation karte hain — jaise 'har department ke top 3 employees'. GROUP BY se farq ye hai ki window functions har row ko alag rakhte hain, group nahi karte.

8. Quick check

Sawaal 1: SQL seekhne ka sabse achha tareeka kya hai?

  • Sirf videos dekhna
  • Har concept ke baad khud queries likh ke practice karna ✓ Sahi jawab
  • Book ratna
  • Sirf theory padhna

Sawaal 2: Joins seekhna kyun zaroori hai?

  • Interview me poochte hain
  • Real data kai tables me banta hai — jode bina useful jawab nahi milega ✓ Sahi jawab
  • Joins fast hote hain
  • Joins ke bina SQL nahi chalti
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: SQL seekho structured tareeke se: basics → joins → aggregation → advanced (window functions) → real project; har roz queries likho; SELECT * ki aadat chhodo; interview ke liye classic questions (top-N, second highest) practice karo.

FComputer Fundamentals · Interview

FAQs — interview sawal

Interview me is part se aksar poochhe jaane wale sawal — har sawal pe click karo, jawab khulega.

Q1OSI model ke 7 layers kaunse hain aur har layer ka kaam kya hai?

Neeche se upar: 1. Physical — bits ko signals me badalna (cables, fiber). 2. Data Link — MAC address, frames, error check (switch). 3. Network — IP address aur routing (router). 4. Transport — end-to-end delivery, TCP/UDP, ports, reliability. 5. Session — connection manage karna (login session, video call). 6. Presentation — format, encryption (TLS), compression, encoding. 7. Application — user se seedha matlab (HTTP, DNS, SMTP, FTP).

Yaad rakhne ki trick: 'Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away' — Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application. Interview me sirf naam nahi, har layer pe kaunsa device/protocol kaam karta hai, ye bhi batao.

Q2TCP vs UDP — kab kaunsa use karein?

TCP use karo jab har packet ka pahunchna zaroori ho: file download, web page, email, login, database — wahan delay chalega, loss nahi. UDP use karo jab speed zaroori ho aur thoda loss chalega: online gaming (position updates), live video calls, DNS lookup, VoIP — wahan ek packet kho jaye to agla aa jayega, par delay bardasht nahi.

Yaad rakhna: TCP = registered post (guaranteed, slow), UDP = postcard (fast, no guarantee). Aur beech ka rasta bhi hai — reliable UDP (QUIC/HTTP-3) zaroori packets ko dobara bhejta hai, baaki ko fast jaane deta hai.

Q3DNS lookup step-by-step kaise hota hai?

1. Browser cache check — pehle dekha hai to wahi se IP. 2. OS/hosts file aur local resolver (ISP ya 8.8.8.8). 3. Root server (.) batata hai .com ka TLD server kahan hai. 4. TLD server batata hai domain ka authoritative nameserver kaun hai. 5. Authoritative nameserver A record deta hai (jaise 93.184.216.34). 6. Browser IP se connect karta hai — aur record TTL tak cache me rehta hai, isliye dobara turant khulta hai.

Interview line: har step pe caching hoti hai — browser, OS, resolver, aur TTL decide karta hai record kitni der valid rahega.

Q4IPv4 vs IPv6 — IPv6 kyun zaroori hua, aur kya farq hai?

IPv4 32-bit hai — sirf 4.3 billion addresses (192.168.0.12 jaise, dots se alag 4 numbers). Devices badhte gaye — phones, IoT, sab ko IP chahiye — to addresses khatam hone lage. IPv6 128-bit hai (8 groups, colons se alag, jaise 2001:db8::ff00:42:8329) — lagbhag 3.4 x 10^38 addresses, matlab har device ko arabon addresses mil sakte hain.

Farq: IPv6 ka header simple hai, NAT ki zaroorat nahi (har device ka apna public address), aur built-in IPsec support hai. Transition ke liye Dual Stack use hota hai — device pe IPv4 aur IPv6 dono ek saath chalte hain.

Q5Process aur thread me kya farq hai? Context switching kyun alag hai?

Process ek independent program hai — apna address space, apni memory, apne resources. Thread process ke andar ka halka worker hai — code, data aur files share karta hai, sirf apna stack aur registers alag hote hain.

Farq: process switch me poora address space aur page table badalni padti hai — mehenga hai. Thread switch me sirf stack aur registers badalte hain — sasta aur fast hai. Isiliye web server 10,000 connections ke liye threads use karta hai, aur browser har tab ke liye alag process use karta hai (isolation ke liye — ek tab crash ho to baaki bachein).

Q6Deadlock kya hai? 4 Coffman conditions aur rokne ke tareeke kya hain?

Deadlock tab hota hai jab do ya zyada processes hamesha ke liye ek doosre ka wait karte rahenge — A ke paas R1 hai aur use R2 chahiye, B ke paas R2 hai aur use R1 chahiye, aur koi aage nahi badhta.

4 conditions ek saath sach honi chahiye: Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait. Rokne ke tareeke: kisi ek condition ko tod do — resources hamesha ek hi order me mango (circular wait khatam), saare resources ek saath mango (hold-and-wait khatam), ya preemption allow karo. Detection ke liye wait-for graph banao, recovery ke liye ek process ko kill karo ya resource preempt karo.

Q7Paging vs segmentation — kya farq hai, aur fragmentation kya hai?

Paging me memory fixed-size pages (jaise 4 KB) me banti hai — process ka address space pages me, physical memory frames me. Address = page number + offset, page table se frame milta hai. Segmentation me memory variable-size segments me banti hai — logical hisso ke hisaab se (functions, objects, data). Address = segment number + offset, segment table se base address milta hai.

Fragmentation: paging me internal fragmentation hota hai (aakhri page me waste jagah), par external fragmentation nahi hota (fixed size ki wajah se). Segmentation me external fragmentation hota hai (variable size ke gaps), par logical separation aur protection/sharing aasan hoti hai. Aaj ke OS dono ko combine karte hain — segmentation ke upar paging.

Q8SQL query andar se kaise chalti hai? Index ka kya role hai?

Steps: 1. Parser query ko samajhta hai aur syntax check karta hai. 2. Optimizer sabse sasta execution plan chunta hai (kaunsa index use kare, join ka order kya ho). 3. Executor plan chalata hai — rows padhta hai, filter/join/aggregate karta hai, result deta hai.

Index ek alag data structure hai (aam taur pe B-tree) jo column ke values ko sorted rakhta hai — jaise kitab ka index. Bina index ke poori table scan karni padti hai (slow); index se seedha sahi rows mil jati hain. Par index free nahi hai — har INSERT/UPDATE pe index bhi update hota hai, isliye har column pe index banana galat hai.

Q9SQL seekhne ka best tareeka kya hai? Roadmap kya hona chahiye?

Stage 1 (Week 1-2) — Basics: SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, DISTINCT. Stage 2 (Week 3-4) — Joins aur aggregation: INNER/LEFT JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, COUNT/SUM/AVG. Stage 3 (Week 5-8) — Advanced: subqueries, CTEs, window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK), indexes. Stage 4 (Week 9+) — Real projects aur interview: ek chhota database banao, real questions solve karo, execution plan padhna seekho.

Pehle SQL ke 5 components samjho — DDL (CREATE/ALTER), DQL (SELECT), DML (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), DCL (GRANT/REVOKE), TCL (COMMIT/ROLLBACK). Data analyst ko DQL sabse zyada chahiye; backend engineer ko lagbhag sab kuch.

Q10UDP ke 4 main use cases kaunse hain, aur wahan TCP kyun nahi use karte?

1. Live video streaming aur video calls — thoda packet loss chalega, delay nahi. 2. Online gaming — position updates har frame aate hain, ek kho jaye to agla aa jayega. 3. DNS lookups — chhota sawaal, chhota jawab; TCP ka handshake hi request se bada pad jayega. 4. IoT aur broadcasting/multicast — ek packet kai devices ko ek saath.

TCP wahan nahi chalta kyunki uska handshake + ACK + retransmission delay banata hai, aur head-of-line blocking se ek khoya packet sab kuch rok deta hai. UDP 'bhejo aur bhool jao' hai — real-time cheezon ke liye yahi sahi hai.

Q118 popular network protocols kaunse hain, aur har ek ka kaam kya hai?

HTTP — web pages lana (port 80). HTTPS — encrypted web (port 443, TLS ke saath). TCP — guaranteed delivery, packets order me (registered post). UDP — fast, no guarantee (postcard). DNS — naam se IP nikalna (port 53, phonebook). SMTP — email bhejna (port 25). FTP — files transfer karna (port 21). WebSocket — TCP pe full-duplex real-time connection — server push karta hai, client baar-baar nahi poochta (gaming, stock trading, chat).

Interview tip: sirf naam nahi, port number aur 'kab kaunsa' bhi batao — jaise DNS UDP pe kyun chalta hai, aur email bhejne (SMTP) aur padhne (IMAP/POP3) me kaunse protocols hain.

Q12DNS record types — A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS — har ek kab use hota hai?

A — domain ko IPv4 address se jodta hai (google.com → 142.250.80.46). AAAA — wahi kaam IPv6 ke liye. CNAME (Canonical Name) — ek domain ka nickname, doosre domain ki taraf point karta hai (alias). MX — email kahan jaye, mail server ka address (priority ke saath). TXT — verification aur policies (jaise SPF) ke liye text. NS — domain ka authoritative nameserver kaun hai.

Website kholni hai to A/AAAA, email bhejni hai to MX, domain verify karna hai to TXT, aur subdomain ko doosre naam se chalana hai to CNAME — har kaam ke liye alag record hai.
